criteria.text: Parse controlled Anthropic request JSON into a normalized scoring prompt and extract the exact BODY section.
criteria.reason: Controlled Anthropic JSON proves metadata decoys are ignored and only the exact BODY section is returned.

criteria.text: Classify candidate only by exact UUID candidate body, classify the deployment-audit draft by purpose and a different body, and require exactly one request each.
criteria.reason: Executable classification covers exact candidate equality, fixture-purpose draft selection, unrelated-purpose rejection, and static one-request assertions.

criteria.text: Abort owned SDK sessions before delete with bounded phase deadlines, request deadlines, concurrency four, and DELETE 404 success.
criteria.reason: Executable workers prove peak concurrency does not exceed four; teardown assertions bind abort/delete ordering, both deadlines, request timeouts, and 404 success.

criteria.text: Provider restoration and remaining strict cleanup always run and cleanup failures aggregate after all phases.
criteria.reason: Static teardown contract proves restoration follows independent session attempts and all fatal cleanup errors aggregate at the end.
